title: Urban Heat Island Index -- added heat from the built environment, per capita average (degrees Fahrenheit)

source.name: Urban Heat Hot Spots in 65 Cities

notes: Climate Central's 2024 analysis of 65 major US cities (50 million residents, 15% of the US population) computed a per-neighborhood Urban Heat Island (UHI) Index -- how many extra degrees pavement, buildings, and lost tree cover add versus a natural land-cover baseline. Per-capita city averages ranged 7.4-9.7 degrees F; the 65-city average was 8.0 degrees F.
